source_feature.meaning: The same original underlying support set may correspond to more than one distinct generated blend face; such sets are not unique persistent identifiers. Preserve two top regions and verify many-to-one tracking without inventing unders encoding.

parts_geometry_immutable: TwoTopRegions cube32, concave wraparound top region1 and inset triangle2; no merging finite partitions or converting to the three-region case25.

world_edge_fingerprints.curve_matching: world position/shape and finite adjacency; analytic fit can be recovered from NURBS, never require same curve class or same topology index

selection.expected_count_applies_to: geometric root chains/support intersections, not arbitrary backend edge segmentation

independent_oracles.assertion: Retain distinct generated face identities even when associated finite source set equals[1,3]; do not collapse face IDs by support-set key. A central distinct region2 contribution must be evidenced at R>6.7.

native_API_mapping.reason: The existing ordinary fillet entry does not itself encode this source option. Capability requires explicit native mapping or a separately labeled composition; missing adapter is not proof of kernel unsupported.

source_clarifications_required: Exact PDF result face labels and native returned association array for Fig73-45 have not yet been independently recovered. Current pair[1,3] is the local reconstructed semantic convention, not known Parasolid entity tags.
